jobs.title: From Static to Adaptive: The Next-Gen Pipeline
jobs.description: From Static to Adaptive: The Next-Gen Pipeline Platform Solution Telemetry Onboarding Data Tranformation and Routing Security Insights Telemetry Onboarding Data Transformation and Routing Security Insights Resources All Blog eBooks Events News From Static to Adaptive: The Next-Gen Pipeline Read more About Us Careers Get a Demo Featured Blog From Static to Adaptive: The Next-Gen Pipeline Omer Schneider CeTu October 5, 2025 | 2 min read Copied In a world where data volumes and threats never stop changing, neither should your pipeline. Most enterprises still rely on static telemetry pipelines - configured once, then left untouched. The result? Overpaying for unused data, slower investigations, and critical alerts buried in irrelevant noise. Adaptive telemetry changes that. It classifies data by how it’s actually used - powering a detection rule, driving a dashboard, or just sitting unused. High-value signals flow where they’re needed most, while low-value data is aggregated, sampled, or dropped automatically. From there, the pipeline adjusts in real time - routing, transforming, and prioritizing based on context and value. This means teams can: Classify on the fly by source, content, and detection relevance Route intelligently , keeping essential data in high-value destinations while pushing non-essential data to lower-cost storage Reduce dynamically to maintain visibility without overspending Continuously re-optimize as costs, performance, and coverage needs shift ‍ What We Uncover in Enterprise Environments ‍ When we examine enterprise telemetry pipelines, we consistently uncover the same issues: ~68% of logs ingested go unused 15–20% of detection rules break down 80%+ of environments show MITRE gaps These patterns illustrate a fundamental truth: even well-designed pipelines degrade quickly. Without adaptivity, teams are trapped in cycles of firefighting rather than staying ahead. The Business Impact ‍ Organizations that adopt adaptive telemetry pipelines can: Surface high-priority alerts faster by reducing noise Adapt seamlessly to new tools, sources, and threats Cut ingestion costs without creating blind spots Keep pipelines aligned with changing business and security needs The choice is simple: Keep chasing yesterday’s problems, or build a pipeline that keeps pace with tomorrow. ‍ Subscribe for News & Updates Thank you!
